units.source_text: 他那淡红色的闪闪发光的衣服的襟袖上尽是眼泪。

en.t: The collar and sleeves of his pale red, shimmering robe were wet with tears.

units.source_text: 那怅望沉思的姿态，异常风流潇洒。

en.t: His pensive, distant-looking figure was extraordinarily graceful and elegant.

units.source_text: 众侍女从帘隙窥看，相与言道：“大小姐青春夭折，其悲哀自不必说了。

en.t: The ladies-in-waiting peered through the gaps in the blinds and said to one another, "The sorrow of the elder young lady dying so young goes without saying.

units.source_text: 这位中纳言大人我们一向见惯，今后将成疏隔，想起了也觉万分可惜。

en.t: We have always been used to seeing this Middle Counselor, and when we think that from now on he will become distant from us, it feels terribly regrettable.

units.source_text: 他和大小姐的交情，真乃意想不到的奇迹啊！

en.t: The bond between him and the elder young lady was truly an unexpected miracle!

units.source_text: 如此深情厚意，而双方终于无缘！”

en.t: With such deep affection and devotion, and yet in the end the two of them were not destined to be together!"
After saying this, they all wept.

units.source_text: 薰中纳言对二女公子说：“

en.t: Middle Counselor Kaoru said to the second young lady, "

units.source_text: 我将视小姐为令姐的遗念，今后无论何事必以奉告，

en.t: I shall regard you as a keepsake of your elder sister, and from now on I will be sure to tell you about everything,
and if you have anything to say, please command me as well.
I would be grateful if you would not keep me at a distance or abandon me."

units.source_text: 二女公子自觉此身万事皆遭不幸，不胜羞耻，

en.t: The second young lady felt that everything about her life had met with misfortune, and she was overcome with shame,
so she never once met him face to face.

units.source_text: 薰中纳言每有感触，想道：“

en.t: Whenever Middle Counselor Kaoru was moved by some feeling, he thought, "

units.source_text: 这二女公子是个爽朗活泼的人，比乃姐富有孩子气而品质高雅。

en.t: This second young lady is bright and lively, more childlike than her elder sister, yet of refined quality.

units.source_text: 但不及乃姐的含蓄温柔。”

en.t: But she does not match her elder sister's reserved gentleness."
